---
title: "The document language overrides the per-language file of an extension"
format: langfile-html
toc: true
lang: fr
language:
  toc-title-document: "Contents from the document"
_quarto:
  tests:
    langfile-html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<h2 id="toc-title">Contents from the document</h2>']
        - ['Sommaire de l extension', 'Contents from the extension']
---

## Section

The `langfile` extension has a `_language-fr.yml` file next to its `_language.yml` file.
The document sets `toc-title-document` under `language`, with `lang: fr`.
The value of the document must replace the value of the French file of the extension.
